supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: prominent extension beyond the lateral canthus of each eye

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: moderate intensity contrast between light-grey muzzle/chin and dark-pigmented periocular regions

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: light-colored depigmented patch or scar on the upper-central forehead
other_distinctive_markers: pronounced white hair fringe along the chin and lower muzzle boundary
